name: MSD-TCA: multi-scale DLinear + target attention
tagline: Two-scale (kernel 15 / 25) DLinear backbone produces all-channel forecasts, then a [1xC] target-only attention over normalized histories conservatively gates exogenous information into the target prediction.
init_recovers: DLinear baseline at exo_gate → -∞ and scale_alpha = 0
diff_from_baseline: Strict superset of the DLinear baseline: averages two decomposition scales and adds a [1xC] target-Q cross-channel attention with a learned gate that blends only into the target dimension.

name: ExAT: variable-token Transformer + global gate
tagline: iTransformer-style variable tokens with a global FFN gate that reweights each variable's history before a Transformer encoder runs cross-variable attention; time features are concatenated as extra tokens.
formula: $$w = \sigma(\mathrm{MLP}(\mathrm{flatten}(x))),\;\tilde x = x \odot w + x,\;\;Z = \mathrm{TransformerEnc}(\mathrm{Linear}(\tilde x^\top) + P_{\text{var}}),\;\;\hat y = \mathrm{Linear}(Z)[\,:C,\,:]$$
diff_from_baseline: Builds on the iTransformer baseline (variable tokens + cross-variable attention) by inserting a learned per-variable global gate and concatenating time-feature variables as extra tokens, then projecting the first enc_in tokens to pred_len.

name: Patch-Time + Variable Attention (PatchTST x iTransformer)
tagline: PatchTST-style time-axis Transformer over patched per-variable series, then a multi-head self-attention across variables on the flattened patch tokens, finally a linear pred_len head.

key_hyperparams.name: embed_dim_var
key_hyperparams.role: flattened token dim for variable attention

init_recovers: PatchTST baseline at variable attention block disabled (set MHA + FFN to identity)
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of PatchTST and iTransformer baselines: keeps PatchTST's per-channel patch encoder but follows it with a Transformer-block over flattened-patch variable tokens before the linear pred_len head.

name: Target-aware decomposition + low-rank correction
tagline: Per-channel anchored trend+residual linear forecast, then a softmax channel gate built from target-attention compatibility blends an exogenous-pooled forecast into the target; a low-rank historical summary adds a shared horizon correction.

key_hyperparams.name: gate_blend
key_hyperparams.role: softmax compat vs MLP-gate prior mix

init_recovers: DLinear-like baseline when gate_blend → 1 trivial gate and target_forecast = base_target
diff_from_baseline: Custom design that combines a DLinear-style anchored trend/residual linear forecast with a target-conditioned channel gate, an exogenous pool, and a low-rank cross-channel residual correction; explicitly overwrites the target output channel after denormalization.
